title: Genes and germs
scene: Anna's aunt works in a biotech lab. She studies the human genome, shows Anna a clone and a mutant fly under the microscope, explains how a microbe makes a toxin and how an enzyme or an inhibitor works, and how scientists fight Ebola and anthrax.

words.ex: She works for a biotech company near the university.
Scientists mapped the human genome.
The sheep in the photo is a clone.
The movie is about a mutant with special powers.
Look at the cells under the microscope.
Microbes live everywhere, even in our bodies.
The liver removes toxins from the body.
Enzymes help the body digest food.
The new medicine is an inhibitor that slows the virus.
Ebola is a very dangerous virus.
Anthrax is a dangerous disease of animals and people.
Actin is a protein that helps muscles move.
I think I have a virus.
A virus is a type of pathogen.
I think it's in my genes.

old_story: Anna's aunt Lida works at a [[biotech]] lab near the university. One day, she invited Anna to visit. "Here we study the human [[genome]]," she said. She showed a photo of a sheep and said it was a [[clone]]. Under the [[microscope]], Anna saw a [[mutant]] fly with tiny extra wings. Then Lida showed her a [[microbe]] that makes a dangerous [[toxin]]. "This [[enzyme]] breaks the toxin down, and this [[inhibitor]] stops the microbe from growing," she explained. Next, Anna looked at muscle cells and learned that the protein [[actin]] helps them move. "Our team also helps doctors fight [[Ebola]] and [[anthrax]]," Lida said. At home, Anna told Max, "Maybe I'll become a scientist too!"

title: Brain, mood and hormones
scene: A lecture at medical school explains the brain: neurons in the cortex, receptors and serotonin, how an antidepressant works, and what happens in mania, paranoia, amnesia and autism. The professor also talks about testosterone and estrogen, the reflex in the knee, the protein actin, every organ, and the placenta in the first trimester.

words.ex: The brain has billions of tiny neurons.
The cortex is the outer layer of the brain.
The drug blocks certain receptors in the brain.
Serotonin is a brain chemical that affects your mood.
The doctor prescribed an antidepressant.
During his mania, he barely slept.
His paranoia made him trust no one.
After the accident, he suffered from amnesia.
Her son was diagnosed with autism last year.
Testosterone is a male hormone.
Estrogen is an important hormone in the female body.
The doctor tested the reflex in my knee.
I felt a rush of adrenaline before the race.
He takes insulin every day for diabetes.

old_story: On Tuesday, Anna went with her friend Ira to an open lecture at medical school. The professor showed a picture of a [[neuron]], one of billions in the brain. "This outer layer is the [[cortex]]," she said. She explained how each [[receptor]] catches chemicals like [[serotonin]], which affects mood. "An [[antidepressant]] can help when a person feels sad for a long time," she said. Then she talked about [[mania]], when people barely sleep, and [[paranoia]], when they trust no one. A student asked about [[amnesia]], when a person loses memories. The professor said that [[autism]] is simply a different way a brain develops and works. Hormones matter too, like [[testosterone]] and [[estrogen]]. At the end, she tapped Ira's knee, and her leg jumped: a perfect [[reflex]]!

title: Medical school
scene: Anna's friend Ira studies at medical school. In anatomy class they work with a cadaver and a scalpel and learn about the abdomen, the appendix, the pancreas, the aorta, the digestive tract and the anus; in the hospital she sees triage, anesthesia, a catheter and a muscle spasm, and reads how doctors once used chloroform.

words.ex: Medical students study anatomy on a cadaver.
The surgeon asked for a scalpel.
He felt pain in his lower abdomen.
The doctor removed his appendix last year.
The pancreas makes insulin to control your blood sugar.
The aorta is the biggest blood vessel in the body.
The digestive tract is about nine meters long.
The doctor examined the patient's anus.
In the emergency room, triage decides who goes first.
The surgery was done under general anesthesia.
The nurse put in a catheter after surgery.
He felt a sharp spasm in his back.
I want to be an organ donor.
The dentist gave me a local anesthetic before the filling.
He has a nervous tic in his eye.
He has a slight tremor in his hands.

old_story: Anna's friend Ira told her about a busy week at medical school. On Monday, her anatomy group studied a [[cadaver]] with great respect. The teacher held up a [[scalpel]] and explained each step. They looked inside the [[abdomen]] and found the small [[appendix]]. Ira also saw the [[pancreas]], which makes insulin, and the huge [[aorta]]. The teacher said the digestive [[tract]] runs from the mouth to the [[anus]]. On Wednesday, Ira watched [[triage]] in the hospital's emergency room. A man with a broken leg had surgery under [[anesthesia]]. Later, a nurse showed Ira how to put in a [[catheter]]. After the long day, Ira felt a sharp [[spasm]] in her back. Still, she called Anna happily: "Today I signed up to be an [[organ]] donor!"

title: On the hospital ward
scene: Ira works on a hospital ward. She meets patients with a tumor, leukemia, anemia, a rare syndrome, asthma, diarrhea and vertigo, learns about polio, penicillin, an antidote and a placebo in medical history, and talks with a family about a hospice and euthanasia.

words.ex: The doctor said the tumor is not cancer.
Leukemia is a cancer of the blood.
Her tiredness was caused by anemia.
The doctor said I have a rare syndrome.
My son has asthma and uses an inhaler.
He got diarrhea after drinking the tap water.
She gets vertigo on tall buildings.
The polio vaccine has saved millions of children.
The doctor gave me penicillin for my sore throat.
The doctor gave him an antidote to the poison.
Her grandfather spent his last weeks in a hospice.
Cholera spreads through dirty water.
The doctor gave me antibiotics for my throat.
He was diagnosed with lymphoma last year.

old_story: On her first day on the hospital ward, Ira met many patients. A young man was happy because his [[tumor]] was not cancer. A brave girl was fighting [[leukemia]], and an old teacher was weak from [[anemia]]. A boy had a rare [[syndrome]], and a little girl showed Ira her [[asthma]] inhaler. A tourist had [[diarrhea]] after drinking tap water, and a painter had [[vertigo]]. At lunch, an old doctor told her stories about [[polio]] and the first [[penicillin]]. Once, he said, a quick [[antidote]] saved a farmer after a snake bite. In one study, some patients felt better after taking only a [[placebo]]. Long ago, [[cholera]] spread through the dirty water of the city. In the evening, Ira helped a family find a quiet [[hospice]] for their grandfather. She went home tired but proud of her work.

title: A castle in England
scene: Anna visits an old castle in England with a stone bastion. A guide tells her about the lord and the duke who lived there, an earl, squires and yeomen, the gentry and every aristocrat, a monarch on the throne with his consort, a regent, a loyal vassal and the loyalists, and a dandy in fancy clothes.

words.ex: We visited the castle of an old lord.
I'm reading a book about a duke and his family.
The earl lived in a huge castle.
The squire owned most of the land around the village.
In old England, a yeoman owned and farmed his own land.
The gentry lived in large country houses.
He was born into a family of aristocrats.
The monarch gave a speech on TV today.
Who will be next on the throne?
The queen's consort stood beside her.
The queen's uncle ruled as regent.
The vassal promised loyalty to his lord.
The baron lived in a large castle.
The museum has a portrait of a Russian tsar.
Kaiser was the title of the German emperor.
The sovereign opened the new session of parliament.

old_story: Anna visited an old castle in England with Max during the summer holidays. They climbed the stone [[bastion]] and looked at the green fields below. A friendly guide said that a rich [[lord]] built the castle long ago. Later, a [[duke]] lived here, and then an [[earl]] bought it. A [[squire]] owned the village nearby, and each [[yeoman]] farmed his own land. The local [[gentry]] came to big dinners in the great hall. Every [[aristocrat]] wore expensive clothes and danced all night. Once, a [[monarch]] visited the castle and sat on a golden [[throne]]. His [[consort]] stood beside him and smiled at the guests. Their son was too young to rule, so his uncle became [[regent]]. A loyal [[vassal]] promised to protect the boy with his life. At the end, Anna posed like a queen for Max's camera.
